name: @tagspaces/tagspaces-md-toolbar
description: MD toolbar plugin used by the TagSpaces application and extensions based on Milkdown editor
author: TagSpaces Authors <contact@tagspaces.org>

scripts.npmpack: npm run build && npm pack && tar -xvf tagspaces-tagspaces-md-toolbar-4.5.52.tgz && npx shx cp -rL package/** ../../../tagspaces/node_modules/@tagspaces/tagspaces-md-toolbar && rimraf package
scripts.npmpack-ext: npm run build && npm pack && tar -xvf tagspaces-tagspaces-md-toolbar-4.5.52.tgz && npx shx cp -rL package/** ../../../tagspaces/extensions/md-editor-crepe/node_modules/@tagspaces/tagspaces-md-toolbar && rimraf package
scripts.pkg-publish: npm run build && npm publish --access public
